subject: Observability evidence & SIEM handoff for Acme Financial (on-prem)
messages:
From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmefin.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmefin.com, procurement@acmefin.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability evidence needed for on-prem rollout

Hi Jasmine,

We’re getting close to the internal audit window for our on-prem deployment and the audit team has asked for the list of observability artifacts Redwood will provide for the Acme Financial VPC/on-prem installation. Specifically they asked for:

- SIEM field mapping and event samples for auth, inference, and admin actions
- Log retention/rotation guidance and where syslog/HEC outputs will land
- Trace hook placement and a recommended sampling policy for production traffic
- A brief packet with artifacts we can include in the audit package (index + expected file formats)

Can you share what you’ll hand over and a proposed timeline? We’re aiming to include the evidence bundle in the audit packet by the close of next week (Mar 25).

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Torres
Head of Security Engineering
Acme Financial
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmefin.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence needed for on-prem rollout

Hi Michael — thanks for the heads up. 

High-level plan we can commit to this week:

1) Deliver an "evidence index" CSV that enumerates exported artifacts and formats (will include syslog/HEC endpoints, S3 paths for stored bundles, retention windows).
2) Provide a SIEM mapping spreadsheet that aligns Redwood-level events -> common SIEM fields (timestamp, user_id, request_id, model, prompt_hash, action_type).
3) Share a short "trace hooks" doc with recommended instrumentation points (ingress, pre-inference, post-inference, admin APIs) and a suggested default sampling (0.5% production, adjustable).
4) Include a network/egress diagram showing where telemetry egress is permitted in the Acme VPC (we'll attach a PNG).

Markus will assemble the SIEM mapping and the diagram; Lauren will confirm retention windows and evidence packaging format. I’ll produce the index and the trace hooks doc.

Can you confirm the auditors need logs in CSV or NDJSON for ingestion? Also let me know any special PII redaction rules we should apply before export.

— Jasmine Liu
Technical Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence needed for on-prem rollout

Jasmine — adding a couple of implementation notes for Markus and Karthis:

- Retention: default production plan for private nodes is 90 days hot + 365 days cold (compressed). We can produce an extracted bundle with configurable windows; auditors usually want 180 days minimum unless Acme has a stricter policy.
- Format: NDJSON preferred for SIEM ingestion (one JSON object per line) — easiest for parsing. We can also emit CSV for summary tables.
- Trace sampling: agree with 0.5% default; for initial spike during handoff we can do 2% for three days to capture more context.
- Redaction: we'll include an exported-redaction-config; by default we redact raw prompt text if Acme requests it, and provide prompt_hash plus length and model metadata instead.

Karthik — Markus will need the exact Kinesis/HEC endpoint and any TLS certs for packaging; can you confirm whether Acme wants the forwarder to push to Splunk HEC or to a private S3 for offline transfer?

- Lauren (Platform PM)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmefin.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence needed for on-prem rollout

Folks — I attached initial artifacts (see filenames below). Quick notes:

- siem_mapping_v1.xlsx: mapping worksheet contains the event types we currently emit and suggested field mappings for Splunk and QRadar. Key events: auth.success/fail, inference.request, inference.response, model.cache.hit/miss, admin.change.
- acme_evidence_index.csv: index of artifact filenames, SHA256 checksums, expected size and recommended retention window per artifact.
- redwood_onprem_integration_diagram.png: network diagram showing where forwarders sit in the VPC and the allowed egress path to either Splunk HEC or S3 presigned-transfer.

Implementation clarifications for Acme (Michael) — per prior conversations we support two export paths:
1) Push to customer-managed Splunk HEC (TLS + token). We will provide the Splunk field mapping and sample events (NDJSON).
2) Offline evidence bundle: we can create a signed tarball of logs/artifacts and hand it to Acme via a presigned S3 link. Tarball manifest will include checksums and a small README with export times.

I attached the first-draft files — they’re short and focused. If auditors want raw prompt text retained, we need explicit written approval from Acme security; otherwise we will redact prompts and include prompt_hash values.

Attachments referenced: siem_mapping_v1.xlsx, acme_evidence_index.csv, redwood_onprem_integration_diagram.png

— Markus Klein
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmefin.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmefin.com, security@acmefin.com
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability evidence needed for on-prem rollout

Thanks everyone — received the artifacts and the diagram looks good. Two quick items before we close the audit packet: 

1) We’ll confirm whether Splunk HEC is preferred or the offline bundle. Procurement asked for a signed acceptance of what will be provided (index + redaction rules). Can you prepare a short acceptance stub we can use for signatures (DocuSign)?
2) For the sampling bump (2%), can you schedule a 72-hour window next Tuesday at 02:00 UTC to 02:00 UTC+3? We’ll coordinate on our side to ensure we can collect the traces.

If you can drop the DocuSign stub and a short runbook for the 72-hour sampling window to the Drive link you already shared, I’ll loop in the auditors and procurement and we’ll mark this thread resolved.

— Michael
Head of Security Engineering
Acme Financial
